subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw expose `memory.capture` and `memory.userModel` now, or defer them until generic SDK registration and invocation contracts enforce their ownership at runtime?
rationale: The branch can load plugins selected for these roles, but loading is not equivalent to controlling the hook or capability that executes; accepting these names now establishes durable public API semantics.

options.title: Defer incomplete roles
options.body: Ship only roles with complete invocation-time routing, then add capture and userModel through explicit SDK contracts in a follow-up.

options.title: Complete all five roles
options.body: Keep the full taxonomy but add role-specific registration, invocation, per-agent enforcement, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for RFC
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while the linked RFC establishes the role taxonomy, lifecycle events, and migration policy.

recommendation.title: Defer incomplete roles
recommendation.body: Ship only roles with complete invocation-time routing, then add capture and userModel through explicit SDK contracts in a follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the central memory capability state, dreaming behavior, per-agent memory work, and plugin SDK contracts that define this product/API choice.
